name: Pyrite Heart
source: When a feud with her brother gets too hot, Princess Ahri Remono, a young woman with a heart of fire, accepts a challenge that she cannot thrive in the world outside the Imperial Palace. In her first day in class, the boisterous princess finds a potential rival in the student body president, Asaio Hayashi. Moving to assert her dominance, Ahri challenges the young man to a series of contests. When each of them end inconclusively, she challenges him to the one thing she hopes he can't be good at, a cook-off. When her rival cheerfully accepts, the young princess realizes that she may have gotten in way over her head.
translation: 当与哥哥的争执白热化时，拥有火热之心的阿莉·雷蒙诺公主接受了一个挑战——她在皇宫外面的世界无法生存。在入学的第一天，喧闹的公主发现学生会长朝生林是一个潜在的对手。为了彰显自己的主导地位，阿莉向这位年轻人发起了一系列比赛。当每场比赛都无法分出胜负时，她向他发起了她希望他不擅长的东西——厨艺对决。当对手欣然接受时，小公主意识到自己可能已经深陷其中了。
